flags.note: Unmatched known issues list is empty, so matches_known is unavailable. The flag is nonetheless worth reviewer time. Post 2 presents three hand-picked holdings with specific returns (94%, 61%, 47%) from the individual-stock sleeve of client portfolios with no performance for the total portfolio they were extracted from and no performance for the remainder of the sleeve. That is C8 (selected positions without total-portfolio performance); the first-pass reviewer mislabeled the code as C4, but the note text they wrote describes C8 almost verbatim, so the code label is wrong while the substance is correct. C4 is also genuinely implicated: 'Our three best ideas of 2025' under the heading 'Three ideas that worked' is an expressly favourable subset selected from a longer record. Same sentence additionally raises C2 (figures appear gross, no net at equal prominence) and C3 (no 1-, 5-, 10-year results). The standard footer's 'Securities discussed may not be held in every client account' and 'Past performance does not guarantee future results' are generic boilerplate and do not supply total-portfolio results, net figures, or the required periods, so they do not cure the issue.
